metadata_prompt:
Extract metadata from the following academic paper text (from page {{page}}).
CRITICAL: Extract the FULL, COMPLETE title for the title field.
Also, generate a shortened "Ai" style title (Target length 10 words, Max length 12 words).
Format your response as a JSON object with keys: "year", "author" (last name only of first author), "venue" (short name), "title", "short_title".
Text: {{text}}
abstract_prompt:
Based on the following paper text, extract detailed information for research management (RAG).
1. Extract the full Abstract.
2. List all authors (full names, comma separated).
3. Extract key words.
4. Generate a 'short_title' if not already clear.
5. Provide a 'summary_info' field (3-5 sentences) covering key findings, methodology, and relevance.
Format your response as a JSON object with keys: "abstract", "short_title", "keywords", "all_authors", "summary_info".
Text: {{text}}
